CodingChangeDraft.description:
A coding-strand substitution the model types (#473 Q2 a): its CDS position
(``c.N``), the reference base and the base it becomes.

cds_position.description: The CDS position, N of c.N.
cds_position.title: Cds Position

ref.description: The reference base on the coding strand.
ref.title: Ref

CodingChangeDraft.title: CodingChangeDraft

InvestigationRequestItem.description:
One target as its request states it: its words, the typed target (an rsID, a
position, a region or a gene and change), the version its source states, how
placement answered it, and who asserts it when that is not the request's own
asserter (#367). Every optional field is left out when empty.
InvestigationRequestItem.title: InvestigationRequestItem

PlacedPosition.description:
Where placement put a target on the Run's assembly (#367): a position no source
states on the Run's version, kept apart from the stated one it came from.
PlacedPosition.title: PlacedPosition

ProteinChangeDraft.description:
A residue change the model types from the words that state it (#473 Q2 a):
the reference residue, its codon number and the residue it becomes, one-letter,
a stop ``*``.

alt.description: The residue it becomes, one-letter; * for a stop (X, Ter, *).
alt.title: Alt

codon.description: The codon number the change names.
codon.title: Codon

ProteinChangeDraft.title: ProteinChangeDraft

RequestPlacement.description:
How placement answered one target (#367): the step that placed it, the written
version name that matched (the source's own, or another name it writes for that
version), the placed position on the Run's assembly and why. A target no step
placed has step ``none``, no position, and its reason.
RequestPlacement.title: RequestPlacement

StatedAssembly.description: The genome version a request's source states, and the line that states it.
StatedAssembly.title: StatedAssembly

StatedChange.description:
A gene and the change a source writes for it: ``PBP2 (Y127X)`` is gene ``PBP2``
and change ``Y127X``, as written (G15's claim, #376). The model types the change
from the words (#473 Q2 a): its transcript when one is written, and a protein
change, a coding change or both. Code reads nothing out of ``change``; a change
with neither typed part is untyped, as a paper's change stays until #383.

change.description: The change exactly as the words write it, e.g. V600E or c.1799T>A.
change.title: Change

coding.description: The coding change the words write, typed.

gene.description: The gene symbol exactly as the words write it.
gene.title: Gene

protein.description: The protein change the words write, typed.

transcript.description: Optional. The transcript accession the words write, as written.
transcript.title: Transcript

StatedChange.title: StatedChange

StatedPosition.description:
Where a request's source places its target, on the version it states: a
sequence as the request names it, a one-based position and, when stated, the
alleles in VCF form (#369).

The sequence keeps the request's own name ("chr11", "NC_000011.10"); naming it
on the Run's assembly is the location lookup's. No coordinates are mapped
between versions here: a position placement, or its lookup (#462 R2), moved is a
`PlacedPosition`.
StatedPosition.title: StatedPosition

StatedRegion.description:
A stretch of one sequence a request names (#367, from #377): the sequence as
named and its first and last one-based positions. Every VCF record in it is its
own outcome.
StatedRegion.title: StatedRegion

amend.description: Amend one member's issue finding: its instruction sends that member back.
amend.title: AmendInvestigationFindingResponse

approve.description: Approve one member's issue finding: checked, not verified (#359).
approve.title: ApproveInvestigationFindingResponse

reject.description: Resolve only this scoped request, retaining its issue and prior evidence.

stop.description: Researcher confirmation that required evidence cannot be supplied.

LocalReferenceSource.description:
A selected local replica of the approved compressed reference.

It carries no byte identity: upload checks the approved publisher md5 and size
while streaming, as for the public URL.
LocalReferenceSource.title: LocalReferenceSource
